summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Lead Management System webhooks and UI. All Wabis and Shopify webhook endpoints working correctly (11 backend tests passed). Frontend UI verified - Marketing Dashboard, Leads List with tabs (All Leads, WhatsApp Leads, Shopify Leads, Other Leads), and Wabis Dashboard all functional.

issues: Console warning: cdn.tailwindcss.com should not be used in production - should use PostCSS/CLI build

action_items: Consider switching from cdn.tailwindcss.com to production Tailwind build
critical_code_review_comments: Webhook endpoints correctly return 200 even on errors to prevent retries from Shopify/Meta
Lead deduplication works correctly - same phone creates single lead
Wabis webhook verification using hub.mode=subscribe pattern works correctly
Shopify completed checkouts are correctly skipped (not treated as abandoned)
COD vs Prepaid detection based on financial_status=pending works
ROAS Metrics placeholder displayed with 'Coming Soon' badge
seed_data_creation: Test webhooks created: 3 WabisCustomers, 3 ShopifyOrders, 2 AbandonedCheckouts, 10 Leads total
context_for_next_testing_agent: All webhook endpoints verified: GET /webhooks/wabis/ (verification), POST /webhooks/wabis/ (message processing), POST /webhooks/shopify/orders/, POST /webhooks/shopify/checkouts/, POST /webhooks/shopify/fulfillments/. UI pages verified: /marketing/dashboard/, /marketing/leads/, /integrations/wabis/. Lead filtering by source (whatsapp, shopify, other) works. Subtabs for WhatsApp (Organic, Ads) and Shopify (Orders, Abandoned Checkouts) present.

wabis_webhook_verification_get.details: Returns challenge on correct verify_token, returns 403 on wrong token

wabis_webhook_post.details: Creates WabisCustomer, WabisMessage, WabisNumber, and Lead records

shopify_orders_webhook.details: Creates ShopifyOrder and Lead, handles COD/Prepaid correctly

shopify_checkouts_webhook.details: Creates ShopifyAbandonedCheckout and Lead, skips completed checkouts

marketing_dashboard.details: Shows Leads Today, Conversions Today, Shopify Orders, WhatsApp Messages, Lead Sources, Recovery Rate, Weekly Trends

leads_list_all.details: Shows all leads with tabs for filtering by source

leads_filter_whatsapp.details: Shows WhatsApp leads with subtabs (Organic, Ads)

leads_filter_shopify.details: Shows Shopify leads with subtabs (Orders, Abandoned Checkouts)

wabis_dashboard.details: Shows webhook URL, verify token, active numbers, leads/messages stats
